title: Invoice
description: Billing document issued to customers for goods or services provided. Tracks invoice details, customer information, payment amounts, tax calculations, payment status, and due dates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the invoice record

invoice_number.description: Unique invoice number or reference code used for tracking and accounting purposes

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to the customer or client this invoice is billed to

customer_name.description: Full name of the customer or business entity being invoiced

customer_email.description: Email address where the invoice is sent and payment notifications are delivered

amount.description: Subtotal amount before taxes and additional fees

tax.description: Tax amount calculated based on applicable tax rates

total.description: Total amount due including subtotal, taxes, and all applicable fees

currency.description: ISO currency code for the invoice amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

status.description: Current payment status of the invoice (e.g., pending, paid, overdue, cancelled, refunded)

issue_date.description: Date when the invoice was created and issued to the customer

due_date.description: Date by which payment is expected or required

paid_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was fully paid, null if still pending
